rules.topic: The crafter spends 100 RF per crafting operation by default; its buffer is 50000 RF with 500 RF/t intake (lines 26/29), and the base speed is 5 operations per work cycle (speedOperations, line 23) - higher crafter tiers raise the operations per cycle, so bulk autocrafting throughput is a tier question, not a config one
